question: Should 2026.6.11 be promoted as the known-good gateway version for fresh setup installs?
rationale: Source inspection proves the patch is narrow, but it cannot prove the upstream 2026.6.11 gateway package is compatible with the Windows setup, WSL, and pairing path.

options.title: Validate And Promote 2026.6.11
options.body: Run or link required repository validation plus a Windows/WSL setup smoke before undrafting and merging the LKG bump.

options.title: Accept The Routine Bump
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally merge after deciding the one-line diff and standing LKG process are sufficient for this candidate.

options.title: Wait For A Later Candidate
options.body: If 2026.6.11 loses known-good confidence, leave the draft paused until automation replaces it with a later gateway version.

recommendation.title: Validate And Promote 2026.6.11
recommendation.body: Run or link required repository validation plus a Windows/WSL setup smoke before undrafting and merging the LKG bump.
